actions.action: Preserve queue age across every reroute
actions.mechanism: Order eligible cases by immutable original arrival time, using a stable sequence number to break ties.
actions.implementation: Make arrival time write-once. Reroute the existing case instead of recreating it; record tag changes separately from queue priority.
actions.check: Submit simultaneous arrivals, then correct wrong tags repeatedly. Verify timestamps remain unchanged and ordering follows arrival time and sequence.
actions.risk: Age preserves priority among eligible cases, not immediate service.

actions.action: Assign against current qualifications and shift capacity
actions.mechanism: Use roster-constrained matching; preserve scarce qualifications when another eligible worker can serve the same case.
actions.implementation: Require language, product expertise, and explicit urgent qualification. Atomically recheck roster availability and capacity when committing each assignment.
actions.check: Test concurrent assignments, shift changes, and zero eligible urgent staff. Reject invalid assignments; keep uncovered urgent cases queued and alert coverage owners.
actions.risk: Roster errors can block service or permit unsuitable assignments.

actions.action: Show separate skill and information waiting states
actions.mechanism: Track missing staffing and missing customer information independently, allowing both blockers without resetting case age.
actions.implementation: Display blocker reasons, original arrival time, and next-action owner. Request specific missing information; reevaluate staffing blockers whenever the roster changes.
actions.check: Create cases with each blocker and both together. Resolve them separately; verify accurate labels and restored arrival-based priority when service-ready.
actions.risk: Unnecessary information requests could conceal staffing delays; audit blocker changes.

actions.action: Validate routing tags before handing cases off
actions.mechanism: Separate uncertain routing labels from verified requirements, preventing guessed tags from authorizing an ineligible assignment.
actions.implementation: Use structured language and product confirmation plus explicit urgency criteria excluding customer status and spending. Send uncertain cases to clarification without changing arrival time.
actions.check: Inject incorrect tags and ambiguous language. Verify confirmation before assignment; vary spending alone and confirm urgency remains unchanged.
actions.risk: Verification adds delay; keep clarification short and visibly tracked.
